name: keepH2Intro off: the h3/table pairs start at the h2 again
why: Without the anchor every pair goes in between the h2 and its intro paragraph, which ends up below the last table (debug/tag-entity-final.html).

name: the intro keeps the stylesheet's 1.5em: short of the h3s' indent
why: The h3 rule's 1.5em is in the h3's own, larger font, so the same em on a paragraph starts left of the h3s; _alignH2Intro() copies the h3's computed margin.

name: the tag path is not previewed
why: A tag link must be a target of the page kind tag; without it in _MB_POP_PAGE_RE no tag link has a card.

name: a kind's count is its list's length, ignoring "See all N"
why: The page lists ten entities per kind; the real count is the See all link's number (59,674 release groups).
grep: the card: genre, total and the kinds by count

name: a kind without "See all" counts nothing
why: Areas lists two entities and has no See all link: its count is the list's length.

name: the pill's vote number has no hover card
why: The number on a Tags card pill is a vote total; its rich card says so.

name: the pill's tag link is no preview target
why: The Tags card's pills are outside any table: they are previewed through the page-wide scope; a kind check that rejects tag leaves them without a card.
